name: class methods fields and descriptors
source: class Point { x=2; constructor(y=3){this.y=y} sum(){return this.x+this.y} } const p=new Point();record(p.sum());record(p instanceof Point);record(Object.keys(p).join(','));record(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Point.prototype,'sum').enumerable);record(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Point,'prototype').writable);record(Point.name+':'+Point.length);try{Point()}catch(e){record(e.name)}

name: class lexical TDZ and mutable declaration
source: try{record(P)}catch(e){record(e.name)}class P {self(){return P}}const Old=P;P=7;record(new Old().self()===Old);const Named=class Inner {self(){return Inner}};record(new Named().self()===Named);record(typeof Inner)

name: derived construction and field order
source: const out=[];class A {a=out.push('a');constructor(x){out.push('A'+x)}}class B extends A {b=out.push('b');constructor(){out.push('before');super(4);out.push('after')}}const b=new B();record(out.join(','));record(b instanceof B);record(b instanceof A);record(Object.keys(b).join(','))

name: derived return and missing duplicate super
source: class A {}class B extends A {constructor(){return {ok:1}}}record(new B().ok);class C extends A {constructor(){}}try{new C()}catch(e){record(e.name)}class D extends A {constructor(){return 1}}try{new D()}catch(e){record(e.name)}class E extends A {constructor(){super();super()}}try{new E()}catch(e){record(e.name)}class F extends A {constructor(){this.x=1;super()}}try{new F()}catch(e){record(e.name)}

name: super property getter setter receiver
source: class A {get x(){return this.value}set x(v){this.value=v}f(){return this.value+1}static f(){return this.value}}class B extends A {set(v){super.x=v}f(){return super.f()+1}static value=8;static f(){return super.f()+1}}const b=new B();b.set(4);record(b.f());record(B.f());record(Object.hasOwn(b,'x'));record(b.value)

name: super follows changed home prototype
source: class A {f(){return 1}}class B extends A {f(){return super.f()}}const b=new B();record(b.f());Object.setPrototypeOf(B.prototype,{f(){return 9}});record(b.f())

name: private fields methods accessors and brands
source: class C {#x=2;#f(){return this.#x+1}get #v(){return this.#x}set #v(v){this.#x=v}go(v){this.#v=v;return this.#f()}has(o){return #x in o}read(o){return o.#v}}const c=new C();record(c.go(7));record(c.has(c));record(c.has({}));record(Object.keys(c).length);try{c.read({})}catch(e){record(e.name)}try{c.has(1)}catch(e){record(e.name)}

source: class C {static #x=3;static #f(){return this.#x}static get(){return this.#f()}}class D extends C {}record(C.get());try{D.get()}catch(e){record(e.name)}

name: static block and computed field initialization order

name: arrow this and lexical super before construction
